summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers an engaging lesson to children about the concept of Ihsan (Islamic excellence), the third level of Islamic practice after Islam and Iman. He uses interactive teaching methods, asking children to recall previous lessons about the Five Pillars of Islam and Six Pillars of Iman. Sh. Ali Mashhour explains that Ihsan means to worship Allah as if you can see Him, or at minimum, knowing that Allah sees you always. He emphasizes this through discussions about the sophistication of the human body (eyes, taste, hands, brain, heart), the presence of eight angels constantly with each person, and divine protection. Sh. Ali Mashhour helps children understand that Allah gave us these incredible abilities and protections so we would be accountable for our actions and motivated to practice worship perfectly.
